name: Kiroc
epithet: Monster Bird, ex-captain of the Black Swan Pirates
personality: Bitter former pirate captain nursing a grudge.
story: Once leader of the Black Swan Pirates, by 1449 he has lost his ship and crew and resents Talimun, head of the Vandal Company, over a past conflict. Recruitment costs Pure Water (3 on Dietrich/Leda routes, 8 on Cai/Theodora).

personalSkill.name: Tyranny
personalSkill.effect: If foe has a status effect, Atk+3 and Crit+10 during combat. Lv20/35: Menace/Menace+ halve enemy dodge chance.

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics B; KeenGamer B. Not missable in Part I: he starts appearing in Dagsion around 5/4 (Dietrich Ch 6) with no known deadline. Pure Water is sold at the Dagsion Item Shop for 500G (Game8).

why: Renown 4 ties with Leda. Neither lord has a support with Kiroc, so roster balance decided it.
recruit.tip: Only 3 Pure Water here, versus 8 on Cai's and Theodora's routes.

build.notes: Joins at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class (Hunter; Ch 6), Archer at Lv 20 (Bow C), Sniper at Lv 35 in Ch 11 to 12 (Bow B): 6th on Dietrich's Part I Advanced list. Carry a Mini Bow so he can counter at range 1 (video: one lies south of Dagsion). Master Crescendo, then Marksmanship. Menace halves enemy Ddg (crit avoid). Tempest Bow and Azaga's Bow are his. Keep him behind the armor line.

guide.summary: Accurate bow sniper. Bow is his only weapon, so stack Hit (Crescendo, Marksmanship) and carry a Mini Bow so he can counter at range 1.
